[11/30 | Foundations, Lesson Title] Foundational Skills-  Unit 3 sessions 6-10
[11/30 | Foundations, Monday (Session 6), Learning Targets] Read and write words with br and gr.
[11/30 | Foundations, Tuesday (session 7), Learning Targets] Read and write words with br and gr.
[11/30 | Foundations, Tuesday (session 7), Learning Targets] Read and add words ed and ing to the end of words.
[11/30 | Foundations, Wednesday (Session 8), Learning Targets] Read and write words with sn and sw.
[11/30 | Foundations, Vocabulary & Strategy] Super Words: into, more, one, your; by, come, my, some
[11/30 | Writing, Monday, Learning Targets] Tell how two ocean animals are alike.
[11/30 | Writing, Monday, Learning Targets] Use verbs in my sentences.
[11/30 | Writing, Monday, I Do] Read the story The Hungriest Mouth In the Sea.
[11/30 | Writing, Monday, I Do] Model writing/drawing the food chain
[11/30 | Writing, Tuesday, Learning Targets] I can use words like isn’t and can’t in my sentences.
[11/30 | Writing, Tuesday, I Do] Model gathering words say: A squid can change colors.
[11/30 | Writing, Wednesday, Learning Targets] Write a fact about an octopus.
[11/30 | Writing, Vocabulary & Strategy] Kelp, ocean, topic, fact, above, below, kelp
[11/30 | Science, Lesson Title] Unit 4: Weather and seasons
[11/30 | Science, Learning Target] Identify weather patterns (Monday-Tues)
[11/30 | Science, Learning Target] Identify the seasons.(Wed-Thurs)
[11/30 | Science, Success Criteria] Name the four seasons (Wed-Thurs)
